Highlights 
China might loosen its tight economic policies? 
There were rumors saying the private high interest 
loans led to the flee of business owners and 
shutdown of their enterprises due to the breaking of 
the funding chain in private enterprises. Although 
enterprises couldn’t get loans from banks, they can 
use the form of trade financing. Under the current 
tight financial situation, the acceptance of enterprises 
couldn’t be discounted, therefore the former fund and 
operating mode are broken down, and the declining 
nonferrous metals prices deteriorates financing, so 
we believe it will spread to the copper industry. 
Inflation has become the focus in macro economy 
since H2 2010. Output gap has continued to decline 
for 18 months since Feb 2010, but began to fluctuate 
in recent 8 months and dropped again in recent 2 
months. From the prospect of the lagged effects of 
conduction (output gap is usually 7 months ahead of 
CPI), inflation reached its peak in Q3 and would 
decline gradually after Q4. We noticed their 
relationship mode changed-the indicating function of 
output gap weakened, indicating that the driven force 
of CPI and competition was different during this 
period, and we judged this round of inflation wasn’t 
driven by demand, but if the inflation was triggered

contradict our common sense. We can ask what is the inner engine of China’s economic growth? We 
should re-think this.  
The liquidity has dropped to the normal level as China’s central bank had continued to conduct tight 
monetary policy. As the first year of the 12th Five-year Plan period, the declining economy must make 
the policy-maker re-consider its monetary policies. 
Economic environment in China and abroad was still complex and faced a lot of uncertainties. Judged 
by the demand and supply relationship, demand of global nonferrous metals will continue to increase in 
2012, and copper and aluminum and other main metals will have a stable production underpinned by 
growing demand. 
China’s macro economic policies will continue to be stabilizing in 2012, and a stable price will be the 
top priority in macro regulation. Further measures will be given to maintain a stable and rapid economic 
development, regulate economic structure and manage inflation, accelerate the transformation of 
development pattern so as to achieve a balanced and rapid economic development. 
It is now the key period in building a well-off society. Domestic demand for non ferrous metals 
continues to increase with the development of industrialization, urbanization and informatization, and the 
development of transportation, energy, affordable houses, infrastructure, and the build of a new 
countryside. The development of new strategic industries also provide strong support on nonferrous metal 
industry, besides, new environmental standards also require the industry to update its development mode 
so as to achieve new and higher goals.  
Production of nonferrous metals will continue to increase in 2012 due to the robust demand. And 
domestic price might be weaker than international market in 2012 due to the policies to curb inflation. 
Refined copper price might average at 69,000 yuan/t. 
 
Copper Market Commentary  
Copper prices fluctuate at a wide rang 
Copper for three month on LME opened at US$6,910/t on Oct.3, and closed at US$8,175/t on Oct.28, 
touching a high of US$8,175/t on Oct.28 and a low of US$6,735/t on Oct.20.  
LME copper prices fluctuated at a wide range, with its closing prices falling below US$7,000/t for 
more than once. G-20 countries have reached an agreement on desirable resolution of the current 
European crisis on Oct. 27, which bolstered equities and resulting in about 6% of growth rate of LME 
3-month copper prices. On the whole, the futures market is not stable. 
Copper for three month on SHFE was weaker than that on LME. Recent SHFE/ LME ratio was 
continuously decreasing. Copper for three month on SHFE opened at 55,060 yuan/t on Oct.10, and closed 
at 59,250 yuan/t on Oct. 28, touching a high of 59,250 yuan/t on Oct.28 and a low of 50,950 yuan/t on

Domestic copper inventory continued to decline in Oct, falling below 100kt. Copper inventory on 
SHFE reached 73,768t on Oct. 28. With copper backwardation rallied above 500 yuan and low copper 
prices, purchase wish of downstream enterprises was enhanced. But trading volumes were still low on the 
whole, due to pessimistic mood for future market. 
Economic environment in China and abroad was still complex and faced a lot of uncertainties. There 
are some pressures on copper prices. But the main influences still come from debt crisis in EU.

Chinese refined copper output has a m-o-m decline in Sept 
Data released by China Nonferrous Metals Industry Association (CNIA) showed refined copper output 
was 457.60kt in Sept, down by 8% m-o-m or up by 18% y-o-y. The accumulative output from Jan to Sept 
was 3.93Mt, up by 15% y-o-y. According to statistics from Antaike, during Jan to Sept, output of 12 
Chinese main refined copper producers produced 2.91Mt, up by 15% y-o-y. Of them, growth rate of 
cumulative refined copper output in Baiyin Nonferrous Metals Company, Shanghai Dachang Copper Co., 
Ltd, Jiangxi Copper Group, Jinchuan Group and Dongying Fangyuan Nonferrous Metals Co. was 
65.45%, 40.01%, 19.25%, 18.74% and 15.09% y-o-y and 14.17% respectively. While output of 12 
Chinese main refined copper producers in Sept had a 0.81% m-o-m decline.  
Copper semis output reached 963.49kt in Sept., up by 3% m-o-m. The m-o-m increase of copper semis 
output was mainly because major domestic copper-using products outputs had a m-o-m rise in Sept., such 
as power generating equipment, AC motor, electric wire and cables. But the coming of off-season 
consumption in air conditioning and refrigeration industry will inhibit consumption at a certain degree in 
future. 
Copper-in-concentrate output was 111.18kt in Sept, slightly up by 2% m-o-m or by 15% y-o-y. The 
accumulative output from Jan to Sept was 919.21kt, up by 12% y-o-y. Analysis of data showed that 
copper-in-concentrate production of Jiangxi, Yunnan, Inner Mongolia, Anhui, Gansu, etc. as China’s top 
5 regions for copper-in-concentrate production, increased by 20.08%, 8.55%, 4.00%, 6.45% and 27.11% 
during Jan to Sept. It is expected that relative good demand in Chinese copper market will further 
promote enthusiasm for production of domestic mine enterprises, as copper prices rebounding recently. It 
is estimated self-produced copper concentrate will maintain at a high level.

Copper consumption  
Because there was 7 holidays to celebrate China’s National Day, major domestic copper-using products 
output in Sept has not been released by National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS). So we can’t 
speculate copper consumption according to ending using products output of copper industry. According to 
Antaike’s research, power cable, as one of copper using large sectors, would still make great contributions 
to copper consumption in Sept. 
In addition, according to the statistics from China Electricity Council, during Jan-Sept investment in 
power source was 242.8 bln yuan, up by 5.1% y-o-y. Of investment in power source, investment in 
hydropower, thermal power, nuclear power and wind power were 63.5 bln yuan, 74.2 bln yuan, 53.2 bln 
yuan and 47.7 bln yuan respectively.  
Statistics from China Electricity Council still released that the newly added power generation capacity 
that has been put into operation in China was 49.62 GW in Jan to Sept, including 8.73 GW of 
hydropower, 32.95 GW of thermal power, 1.09 GW of nuclear power and 6.58 GW of wind power. 
Investment in power grid was 220.1 bln yuan, up by 11.3% y-o-y. newly built power substation capacity 
(above 220 kv) with capacity was 128,170,000 kva, with the length of 22,507 km. At present, electric 
power industry is still the very import copper consumption sector.

Chinese refined copper imports rise in Sept 2011 
Data released by China Customs showed China’s refined copper imports rose to 275.50kt in Sept., up 
by 17% m-o-m, hitting fourth consecutive m-o-m growth in 2011. Refined copper import rose by 14% 
y-o-y in Sept.. In Sept. and Oct., some investors bought LME near dated contracts and sold SHFE futures 
contracts, which added imports. But as shrinking SHFE/LME arbitrage, refined copper imports might be 
affected. 
China’ refined copper export reached 2.39kt, down by 20% y-o-y. Due to recovering domestic copper 
demand, enterprises began rebuilding inventory. So refined copper exports will have a certain decline in 
the future. 
Copper scraps import reached 418.36kt in Sept, down by 2% y-o-y or up by 9% m-o-m. Domestic 
copper scrap supply was less and quality was also not good. Copper scrap import is in accordance with 
copper prices. It is expected copper scrap import will be at 400kt in Oct. 
As to copper concentrate, China’s copper concentrate import reached 562.33kt in Sept., down by 18% 
y-o-y and by about 17% m-o-m. Although copper concentrate import had a m-o-m decline, copper 
concentrate import in Sept was still higher more than that in the most months of H1 2011. That is to say, 
continuous high output of domestic refined copper stimulates copper concentrate import at a certain 
degree. It is estimated that copper concentrate import will keep at a similar level in Oct.

According to sources from Jinchuan Group Ltd., recently, its 350ktpy sulfuric 
project was completed and put into operation, which means that the flue gas 
integration treatment technique is up to new level. 
The project, with total investment of 230 mln yuan, introduced advanced wet 
gas cleaning craft, and double conversion and double absorption process. 
Newly-added flue gas recycling capacity was 140,000 standard cubic meters, 
resulting in reducing SO2 emission of 220kt.   
 Jinchuan Group is a Chinese company based in Gansu. Jinchuan Group now 
has sulfuric acid capacity of 2.52Mtpy and sulfur dioxide utilization rate is 95% or 
above.

According to sources from Dongying Fangyuan Nonferrous Metals Group Co., 
Ltd, its refining capacity will reach 400ktpy by the end of 2011 and smelting 
capacity will reach 400ktpy by the end of 2012.  
Fangyuan Nonferrous Metals Group, established in 1998, mainly engages in 
refined copper production. The company ranks first among non-state owned 
enterprises, one of the top hundred strongest enterprises in Shandong Province and 
one of five hundred strongest enterprises nationwide. It is expected that refine 
copper output in Fangyuan Nonferrous Metals Group will reach 230kt in 
2011, while it was 210kt in 2010. 
 
According to sources from Sichuan Hongda Co., Ltd (Sichuan Hongda, 600331, 
SH), its Moly-Cu polymetallic resources deep processing project has been 
approved at general meeting of shareholders. The project would be built at 
Shifang Industrial Zone, Sichuan Province and start construction after getting 
approval of Ministry of Environmental Protection of the People's Republic of 
China.  
The project will be built by two stags with production capacity of 40ktpy 
molybdenum (metal content) and 400ktpy refined copper. The total investment 
will be 10.48 bln yuan, with 35% self-raised funds of the total investment.  
Sichuan Hongda is principally engaged in the manufacture and distribution of 
zinc ingots and chemical products. The Company's major products are zinc ingots, 
calcium hydrophosphate, refined zinc and etc. 
 
Guangdong Fengkai Yuanzhushan copper-molybdenum mine with proven 
reserves of 1 Mt (about 250kt molybdenum) was signed to be mined on Oct. 13. 
The total investment was 5 bln yuan. The deposit was considered as China's 
second largest copper-molybdenum mine, after Dexing copper mine.  
This mine is porphyry copper deposit, and its potential economic value is 
estimated to be over 500 bln yuan. 
 
According to sources from Ningbo Changzhen Copper Co., Ltd (Changzhen 
Copper), the company held opening ceremony for 50ktpy renewable and 
environment friendly type high-precision copper semis project (stage 2) on Oct. 
13.  
The first stage of the project was completed in 2008. To speed up 
transformation and upgrading, the company decided to implement stage 2 of the 
project with investment budget of 140 million yuan. After completion of stage 2, 
production capacity of high precision copper semis will reach 50ktpy.  
Changzhen Copper,a private company, engages in producing environment 
friendly copper semis using domestic and overseas copper scraps as raw materials.

According to sources from Xinjiang Xinhui Copper Company, a holding 
company of Zhaojin Mining Industry Company, one copper expanding project 
was to be completed before 2013 in Kashgar, Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous 
Region. The project included one 90ktpy copper blister production line and one 
100ktpy copper smelter. There are now one 10ktpy copper blister production line, 
one 140kg gold smelter, one 10tpy silver smelter and one 50ktpy 
copper-gold-silver processing line in Kashgar. 
In Nov. 2011, Zhaojin Mining Industry Company acquired 41% shares of 
Xinjiang Xinhui Copper Company at US$22.02 million and now owns 92% of its 
shares. 
 
Guangdong Chaohua Technology (Chaohua Technology, 002288) planned to 
raise up to 610 million yuan through a private placement of a maximum of 41.2 
million shares. Raised money was for 8kt high-precision copper foil project and a 
project from a research center in Guangdong province. The research center will 
mainly specialize in ultra thin electrolytic copper foil manufacturing technology, 
and the design of high-performance copper clad laminates.  
After completion of the project, Chaohua Technology can produce copper foil 
product, with 35-8 M Micron thickness. Of them, partial products will meet the 
company itself production needs of printed circuit boards (PCB), copper-clad 
laminates (CCL) and others are for sales.  
Chaohua Technology is principally engaged in the manufacture and distribution 
of electronic components. The Company's major products are PCB, CCL, copper 
foils and woody paper. 
 
According to sources from Chongqing Machinery & Electronics Holding 
(Group)., Ltd (Chongqing Machinery & Electronics Group), recently the group 
planned to invest 1.5 bln yuan in 100ktpy refined copper project. The project is 
expected to be commissioned in 2015. 
Chongqing Machinery & Electronics Group, a state-owned holding group 
company, mainly engages in industries including vehicles and vehicle parts, 
electrical appliances, machine tool, electronic information, nonferrous smelting, as 
well as sale and service for rail transit products. 
 
Minmetal Resources announced on Sep. 30 that its wholly-owned subsidiary, 
Album Enterprises, intended to offer CAD 1.3 billion for all issued ordinary 
shares of Anvil Mining, 39% higher than the trading price of CAD 5.77 per share 
on the Toronto Stock Exchange. 
 Anvil Mining's copper production was 9.32kt by the end of June of 2011, 
including 5.94kt copper concentrate and 3.38kt refined copper. Its main assets 
were the two copper mines in Katanga Province, Congo.

According to sources from Xinxing Ductile Iron Pipes (Zhejiang) Copper Co., 
Ltd.(Xinxing Copper Co.), its 150ktpy oxygen-free copper rod project achieved its 
designed capacity in October after the continuous casting and rolling production 
line was formally put into production in September.  
Xinxing Copper Co. is a tertiary enterprise of Xinxing Cathay International 
Group Co., Ltd. Xinxing Copper Co. signed a strategic cooperation agreement 
with Fuyang municipal government to invest 3 bln yuan in 300ktpy refined copper 
and 150ktpy high grade copper semis. 
 
Guangdong Xinmingzhu Ceramic Group has made an agreement about the 
acquisition of Foshan Dajiang Copper Industry Co.,ltd (Foshan Dajiang Copper) 
with 260 mln yuan. Foshan Dajiang Copper's assets are now being liquidated. 
 Foshan Dajiang Copper is capable of smelting and deeply processing copper. 
Foshan Dajiang Copper can produce 50kt copper tubes every year. Copper tube 
production was stopped in late Aug. 
 
According to sources from Jinchuan Group Ltd., the key equipments of 60ktpy 
high-precision copper tube production line were 55MN direct double-action 
extruder and 35MN indirect extruder introduced from Italy, which is up to the 
world advanced level. 
 Jinchuan Group is a Chinese company based in Gansu. Jinchuan Group has the 
copper smelting capacity of 250ktpy and copper refining capacity of 400ktpy. The 
newly-added copper refining capacity will reach 200ktpy by the end of 2011. 
 
According to sources from Xiangguang Copper Co., Ltd (Xiangguang Copper), 
the company has been accorded LME registration, becoming the first private 
Chinese copper producer listed on the world largest and most well-known metals 
exchange market. Standard Bank Group (SBG) has sponsored the registration of 
Xiangguang's copper cathode with the LME, making it the eighth Chinese copper 
company registered on the LME. 
 The company's copper cathodes are now being traded under the symbol 
"XGC", which has been approved as a "Grade A" copper brand by the LME. The 
copper cathodes produced by Xiangguang adopt the most advanced technology in 
the production process -- double flashing furnace, which is the world's second and 
China's only copper smelter adopting this technology. 
 
 According to sources from Far East Holding Group Co., Ltd, the group 
launched three business platforms: cable networks, cable trading treasure and 
China Cable Material Exchange. China Cable Material Exchange opening 
ceremony was held in Yixing City, Jiangsu Province on Sep. 5. 
 China Cable Material Exchange is the world's first trading platform for the 
cable material, mainly for copper, aluminum, plastic, rubber and other 
commodities continuous spot trading. Now the listing products are copper rod, 
aluminum rod and 3mm copper wire.

According to sources from 2011 China (Qingdao) International Mining Expo & 
Summit Forum, despite recent low copper prices, the demand in Copper 
Concentrates is still strong. Experts attending the meeting thought that copper 
mining rights dealings might fluctuate up in late 2011. 
 In coming years, growth rate of China copper demand will be about 5%~10%. 
Considering over 80% of dependence on foreign copper mines and expanding 
smelters/refineries, experts expected copper market might fluctuate up in 2011. 
According to reports, domestic average copper consumption is 5.7kg per 
person, which is far lower than 10~20kg of developed countries. Global copper 
mining is still scarce. In recent five years, copper production will keep at 12.25 
mln t. Domestic large scale copper mines has entered the late stage. Meanwhile, 
the further industrialization is going on. All of these will give impetus for copper 
demand. 
Under the guidance of Export-Oriented Strategy, China Copper enterprises are 
going out to operate mines. The ideal targets are Chile, Peru, Zambia, Russia, 
Australia, Kazakhstan, etc. Among them, CHALCO, Jiangxi Copper Company 
and China Nonferrous Metals Group will take over copper mine projects with 
above 150ktpy production capacity. 
 
Yunnan Copper Co., Ltd. (Yunnan Copper, 000878, SH) released its Q1-Q3 
report of 2011 on Oct.19. During Jan to Sep, its operating revenue reached 25.82 
bln yuan, up by 16.83% y-o-y; net profit attributable to shareholders was 806.06 
mln yuan, up by 215.34% y-o-y. In Q3, its operating revenue reached 9.21 bln 
yuan, up by 9.46% y-o-y; net profit attributable to shareholders was 231.57 mln 
yuan, up by 473.79% y-o-y.

According to sources from Huaxiang Mining Co., Ltd, its 
molybdenum technological upgrading project was completed and put into 
operation. The whole construction period was 3 months. After completion of this 
project, its mining capacity rose to 5kt/d from previous 500t/d and 4.5t 
molybdenum concentrate was produced per day. The molybdenum mine is located 
in Liushengdian, Antu County, Jilin Province.   
 
During Jan-Aug Heilongjiang Maobaogou molybdenum mine produced 343t 
molybdenum concentrate, up by 161.8% y-o-y. 
Maobaogou molybdenum mine is located in Xunke County, Heilongjiang 
Province, covering 5.89 sq. km. Maobaogou molybdenum mine is exploited by 
Heilongjiang Jiangzelong Mining Company. There are 2 ore types (ferro 
molybdenum ore and molybdenum ore), with 12.07kt molybdenum metal and 
molybdenum ore dressing recovery percentage of 80%. Maobaogou molybdenum 
mine can produce 150t molybdenum concentrate (metal content; 45% Mo) per 
year.
